scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, capture receipts, and every assigned screenshot tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md and README.md were read fully; the published-mathematics audit workflow and quantum-algorithms lane-06 schema/conventions were reviewed.
review_method.rendering: Every receipt-listed PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution. Tiles were reviewed separately, with no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and complete ItemBody was reviewed through its rendered tiles and compared using the frozen snapshot, current source, assigned local HTML, screenshot receipt, and PNG hashes.
review_method.boundary: Local read-only review only. No network, builds, tests, gates, commits, pushes, source edits, application edits, or publication-status changes. Only lane-06.md and lane-06.json were written.

diagram_review.existing_diagrams: No assigned ItemBody includes a rendered TikZ diagram; receipts report tikz_count 0 and diagram_failures 0 across the lane. The mathematical notation in the opened tiles is legible, with no confirmed rendering, clipping, or diagram-math defect.

candidates.claim: The checks are indexed by a periodic square cellulation: A_{i,j} is the X product on four edges incident to q_{i,j}, while B_{i,j} is the Z product on the four edges in the boundary of f_{i,j}.
candidates.concrete_content: A small periodic-square-lattice sketch with a highlighted vertex q_{i,j} and face f_{i,j}, labeling horizontal/vertical edges h and v and distinguishing the four incident-edge X support from the four boundary-edge Z support. Match the indices and edge order in lines 39 and 47, and mark periodic identification. This is an optional editorial aid; the written definition and proof are complete and do not rely on a diagram.

candidates.claim: A gate node has one successor; a Pauli measurement node branches on b=0,1 with p_b=Tr(ρP_b), normalized child state only for p_b>0, and no conditional state on a zero-weight branch.
candidates.concrete_content: A small rooted tree showing a unary gate node followed by a two-outcome measurement node labeled b=0,1 and p_b, with child-state update P_bρP_b/p_b on positive branches and an explicitly marked impossible/undefined conditional state on a p_b=0 branch. Include a later gate choice keyed to the observed transcript to convey deterministic classical feed-forward. Preserve the distinction between branch weight and conditional state. This is an optional editorial aid; the definition is explicit and no proof depends on a diagram.
